criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame a physical render, deck dark; 1, 9 and 4 strongest. Frame 3 missing its car and phone, labels on plates, grey-middle; frame 5 primitive monitor with blank bars and flat clip; frame 8 a mid-grey slider rule, striated plug, dead lower band; frame 6 grey plugs with rim-deep casts and wedges; frame 2 slab phone on boxes, empty upper screen; the SDF dog a figurine at native size.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck: box changes state, one dog, the light holds, no strobe; 6 to 8 read as a separate product sheet, 6 and 7 two grids.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every fact traces to primary releases, quotes verbatim, numerals traced, the 2019 absence stated; classification rests on a corporate release.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where, when and next are clear; the appearance stake drawn and asked; stays general, nothing to act on.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover and slide 2 pay, real turn at 6; 3 and 5 overlap; the close lands softly.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and careful; leans on release phrasing; frame 9's hook flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh concept, first animal and first street-level camera opening; lastLight again and a plan-view tile relief.

ranked_defects.defect: Missing car and phone; plates; a gold line through the footer band.
ranked_defects.fix: Frame the roof and phone at the bottom, drop the plates, clip the lines above the footer.

ranked_defects.defect: Mid-grey slider rule, striated plug, shadow artifact, dead lower band.
ranked_defects.fix: Dark steel rule, caliche plug, fixed cast, larger block.

ranked_defects.defect: Blank grey check bars, flat clip, primitive monitor.
ranked_defects.fix: Four lit check words, real render on the screen, screen-only light.

ranked_defects.defect: Grey plugs, rim-deep casts, wedge artifact.
ranked_defects.fix: Pale caliche, taller plugs, longer casts, keyMask falloff.

ranked_defects.defect: Second grid; grey segmented rule; flat black pockets.
ranked_defects.fix: Lit pocket walls and cast floors; inlaid dark steel rule.

ranked_defects.defect: Slab phone on a box clamp, empty upper screen, no real dog through the window.
ranked_defects.fix: Model the clamp, fill the screen, add the real dog beyond the glass.

ranked_defects.defect: Figurine dog; seal reads as a letterbox.
ranked_defects.fix: Coat breakup; curved occluder with a reflection.
Fur breakup; lower camera to crop the walk.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Lines converge on nothing; plates; grey middle.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Roof rail, rear glass and window_phone in the bottom fifth with a lit lens bead; no plates.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Slider rule, striated plug, dead clay.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dark blued steel rule under L* 20, caliche plug, enlarge 1.4 times.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive boxes, wireframe check rows, flat clip.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Check words in screen type with gold ticks, screen-only light.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey plugs, rim casts, wedges, no pool falloff.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: #E4D8C3 plugs, taller with longer casts, keyMask pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Slab phone, empty upper screen, no real dog.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model the clamp, fill the screen, real dog through the window.
